items.name: v17.0.0
items.body:
Attention: We currently advise against upgrading to Forgejo 17.0.0. An issue is currently being investigated that prevents pushing, merging, or other code operations in some cases.

If you haven't updated yet, please wait until the issue has been investigated more thoroughly, if possible.

***

See https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/branch/forgejo/release-notes-published/17.0.0.md
